comment:
* A representation of settings that apply to a collection of similarly themed notifications.
 *
 * Setters return {@code this} to allow chaining.
 *
 * This class doesn't do anything on older SDKs which don't support Notification Channels.

variables.name: DEFAULT_CHANNEL_ID
variables.comment:
* The id of the default channel for an app. This id is reserved by the system. All
     * notifications posted from apps targeting {@link android.os.Build.VERSION_CODES#N_MR1} or
     * earlier without a notification channel specified are posted to this channel.

variables.name: mId
variables.comment: These fields are settable through the builder

methods.name: NotificationChannel getNotificationChannel()
methods.comment:
* Gets the platform notification channel object.
     *
     * Returns {@code null} on older SDKs which don't support Notification Channels.

methods.name: public Builder toBuilder()
methods.comment: * Creates a {@link Builder} instance with all the writeable property values of this instance.

methods.name: public String getId()
methods.comment: * Returns the id of this channel.

methods.name: public CharSequence getName()
methods.comment: * Returns the user visible name of this channel.

methods.name: public String getDescription()
methods.comment: * Returns the user visible description of this channel.

methods.name: public int getImportance()
methods.comment:
* Returns the user specified importance e.g. {@link NotificationManagerCompat#IMPORTANCE_LOW}
     * for notifications posted to this channel. Note: This value might be >
     * {@link NotificationManagerCompat#IMPORTANCE_NONE}, but notifications posted to this channel
     * will not be shown to the user if the parent {@link NotificationChannelGroup} or app is
     * blocked.
     * See {@link NotificationChannelGroup#isBlocked()} and
     * {@link NotificationManagerCompat#areNotificationsEnabled()}.

methods.name: public Uri getSound()
methods.comment: * Returns the notification sound for this channel.

methods.name: public AudioAttributes getAudioAttributes()
methods.comment: * Returns the audio attributes for sound played by notifications posted to this channel.

methods.name: public boolean shouldShowLights()
methods.comment: * Returns whether notifications posted to this channel trigger notification lights.

methods.name: public int getLightColor()
methods.comment:
* Returns the notification light color for notifications posted to this channel. Irrelevant
     * unless {@link #shouldShowLights()}.

methods.name: public boolean shouldVibrate()
methods.comment: * Returns whether notifications posted to this channel always vibrate.

methods.name: public long @Nullable [] getVibrationPattern()
methods.comment:
* Returns the vibration pattern for notifications posted to this channel. Will be ignored if
     * vibration is not enabled ({@link #shouldVibrate()}.

methods.name: public boolean canShowBadge()
methods.comment:
* Returns whether notifications posted to this channel can appear as badges in a Launcher
     * application.
     *
     * Note that badging may be disabled for other reasons.

methods.name: public String getGroup()
methods.comment:
* Returns what group this channel belongs to.
     *
     * This is used only for visually grouping channels in the UI.

methods.name: public String getParentChannelId()
methods.comment:
* Returns the {@link #getId() id} of the parent notification channel to this channel, if it's
     * a conversation related channel.
     * See {@link Builder#setConversationId(String, String)}.

methods.name: public String getConversationId()
methods.comment:
* Returns the {@link ShortcutInfoCompat#getId() id} of the conversation backing this channel,
     * if it's associated with a conversation.
     * See {@link Builder#setConversationId(String, String)}.

methods.name: public boolean canBypassDnd()
methods.comment:
* Whether or not notifications posted to this channel can bypass the Do Not Disturb * {@link android.app.NotificationManager#INTERRUPTION_FILTER_PRIORITY} mode. * *

This is a read-only property which is only valid on instances fetched from the * {@link NotificationManagerCompat}.

methods.name: public int getLockscreenVisibility()
methods.comment:
* Returns whether or not notifications posted to this channel are shown on the lockscreen * in full or redacted form. * *

This is a read-only property which is only valid on instances fetched from the * {@link NotificationManagerCompat}.

methods.name: public boolean canBubble()
methods.comment:
* Returns whether notifications posted to this channel are allowed to display outside of the * notification shade, in a floating window on top of other apps. * *

This is a read-only property which is only valid on instances fetched from the * {@link NotificationManagerCompat}.

methods.name: public boolean isImportantConversation()
methods.comment:
* Whether or not notifications in this conversation are considered important. * *

Important conversations may get special visual treatment, and might be able to bypass DND. * *

This is only valid for channels that represent conversations, that is, those with a valid * {@link #getConversationId() conversation id}. * *

This is a read-only property which is only valid on instances fetched from the * {@link NotificationManagerCompat}.
